meta.name: cold-outbound-sequencer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build a B2B cold-outbound sequence", "design reply-triage branching", "plan a domain warmup / sending throttle", or "make my outbound CAN-SPAM / opt-in compliant"; produces a multi-step outbound sequence with reply-triage branches (positive / objection / referral / not-now / opt-out), a warmup + send-throttle ramp schedule, jurisdiction opt-in/CAN-SPAM guardrails (guidance, not legal advice), and a SEND S-dimension read. Not for B2C lifecycle flows — use email-sequence-designer; not for the consent record — use consent-registry; not for computing EQS — use email-quality-auditor. B2B冷启动外联序列/回复分流/域名预热

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成B2B冷启动外联序列与回复分流方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在规划B2B冷启动邮件外联流程
copy.tagline_en: Generate B2B cold-outbound sequences with reply-triage branching
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning a B2B cold email outreach flow

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计一套 B2B 冷启动外联流程：包括多步骤的邮件序列、回复分流规则、域名预热计划、发送限速，以及 CAN-SPAM 和 opt-in 合规指引。它还会读取发件人信誉（S 维度）并给出评分。
howto.when: 当你要求“构建 B2B 冷启动外联序列”、“设计回复分流”、“规划域名预热/发送限速”或“让外联符合 CAN-SPAM/opt-in 合规”时触发。

say.text: 为我的外联设计回复分流：将积极、异议、转介绍、暂不、退订分别路由到不同分支。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个分支表。

say.text: 我有 3 个新邮箱，请规划一个预热计划和每日发送限速。
say.note: Claude 会给出每周每邮箱的发送量建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design a B2B cold-outbound program: a multi-step sequence with reply-triage branching, domain warmup ramp, per-mailbox send throttle, and CAN-SPAM/opt-in compliance guardrails. It also reads the SEND S (Sender-integrity) dimension and provides a score.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build a B2B cold-outbound sequence", "design reply-triage branching", "plan a domain warmup / sending throttle", or "make my outbound CAN-SPAM / opt-in compliant".

say_en.text: Design a 5-step cold-outbound sequence for SaaS CTOs.
say_en.note: Claude outputs steps, timing, exit rules.

say_en.text: I have 3 new mailboxes. Plan a warmup ramp and daily send throttle.
